scope: Studio Host conformance required; provider-only execution cannot synthesize or attest Host grant state

cases.setup: Start a resource handoff and cancel before the receiver Worker starts.
cases.expected: No receiver execution and no new result; original source result remains available.

cases.setup: Revoke resource.read after the UI grant is displayed but before Worker invocation.
cases.expected: Host rejects the invocation before guest resource reads; no encoded result is produced.

cases.setup: Change or expire the resource contentVersion after grant creation and before invocation.
cases.expected: Host rejects the stale grant; no bytes are exposed and no encoded result is produced.
